notes: TESTERToken (src/TESTERToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments: name, symbol, decimals and totalSupply are compile-time constants, and the constructor assigns the whole 1,000,000,000 TESTER (1e27 minor units) to msg.sender, the launch factory, in one Transfer from the zero address. There is no owner, no admin, no mint, no burn, no pause, no blacklist and no upgrade path; the contract makes no external calls and its runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. transfer and transferFrom move exactly the requested amount with no fee, tax or limit, so the factory's transfer of the swarm's 10% to the Merkle distributor, the single-sided seed through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager and the remainder forwarded to remainderTo all arrive whole, as do distributor claims and trader swaps. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance only, computed with TESTER as currency0; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply using the deployed currency order.
